title: Available capacity
summary: The machine worker allowance counts sessions and unregistered in-flight launches that another session requested; MAIN sessions, interactive or operator-launched without a requester session, spend no worker lane. Registration counts once; ended or terminated workers release capacity. The memory-derived minimum is one worker and explicit limits win. Rejected placement retains real occupancy and cap; unweighed model-pool population is unknown, not zero. Source behavior awaits released first-work receiving proof.
